import TransposeFollowup.ReusableRow
open TransposeFollowup
def identityMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def doubleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 2
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1 / 2
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def fractionalMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 1
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num


def shiftMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := -1; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def poleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := -2; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def coefficientMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1 / 2; b := 1 / 3; c := 1 / 5; d := 1; lo := -1 / 2; hi := 3 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def outsideMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 2; hi := 3
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def cases : List RationalMobius :=
  [identityMap, doubleMap, fractionalMap, shiftMap, poleMap, coefficientMap, outsideMap]


def negativeMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := -2; hi := -1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def zeroHiMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := -1; hi := 0
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num


def negativeCoefficients : RationalMobius where
  a := -1; b := -2; c := 1; d := -3; lo := 4; hi := 5
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num


open FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine RowExecution

def bits (m n : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map n.testBit

def sourceIndex : SourceEndpoints.Port → Nat
  | .shared .dimension => 0 | .shared .index => 1 | .shared .unit => 2
  | .shared .zero => 3 | .shared .fuel => 4 | .shared .scratch => 5 | .shared .grid => 6
  | .shared (.work j) => 7+j.val | .shared (.out j) => 11+j.val | .other j => 14+j.val

def imageIndex : SourceImages.Port → Nat
  | .source p => sourceIndex p | .work j => 17+j.val | .out j b => 20+2*j.val+(if b then 1 else 0)
def prepIndex : RowPreparation.Port → Nat
  | .images p => imageIndex p | .threshold j => 28+j.val | .crossing j => 32+j.val | .temp => 36
def portIndex : Port → Nat
  | .prep p => prepIndex p | .counter => 37 | .stream => 38

def sourcePorts : List SourceEndpoints.Port :=
  ([EndpointClip.Port.dimension,.index,.unit,.zero,.fuel,.scratch,.grid] ++
    (List.finRange 4).map EndpointClip.Port.work ++ (List.finRange 3).map EndpointClip.Port.out).map
      SourceEndpoints.Port.shared ++ (List.finRange 3).map SourceEndpoints.Port.other

def imagePorts : List SourceImages.Port := sourcePorts.map SourceImages.Port.source ++
  (List.finRange 3).map SourceImages.Port.work ++
  (List.finRange 4).flatMap (fun j => [SourceImages.Port.out j false,SourceImages.Port.out j true])
def prepPorts : List RowPreparation.Port := imagePorts.map RowPreparation.Port.images ++
  (List.finRange 4).map RowPreparation.Port.threshold ++ (List.finRange 4).map RowPreparation.Port.crossing ++ [.temp]
def ports : List Port := prepPorts.map Port.prep ++ [.counter,.stream]
def heads (p : Port) : Int := 31*(portIndex p : Int)-317


def blank (w : Tape Bool) : Bool :=
  w.left.all (fun x => decide (x=.blank)) && w.right.all (fun x => decide (x=.blank))

def noise (p : Port) : Tape Bool :=
  if p=.stream then RowStream.closedTape [true,false,false,true]
  else Counter.marked ((List.range (portIndex p%7)).map (fun j => decide ((j+portIndex p)%2=0)))

def cleanupCheck (m flavor : Nat) : Bool :=
  let words := fun j : Fin 30 => (List.range m).map (fun k =>
    if flavor=0 then false else if flavor=1 then true else decide ((j.val+k)%2=0))
  let bank := fun p : Port =>
    if p=.prep .temp then BinaryCarry.preparedOutput else
    match (List.finRange 30).find? (fun j => decide (RowCleanup.dirtyPorts j=p)) with
    | some j => Counter.marked (words j)
    | none => noise p
  let c := NativeZipper.run RowCleanup.program (120*m+154)
    (RowCleanup.zipperCfg RowCleanup.start bank heads)
  decide (c.core.pc=.done) && ports.all (fun p =>
    decide (c.pos p=heads p) &&
    if decide (p=.prep .temp) || (List.finRange 30).any (fun j => decide (RowCleanup.dirtyPorts j=p)) then blank (c.core.tapes p)
    else decide (c.core.tapes p=bank p))

def checks : Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut count := 0
  let mut failures := 0
  for m in List.range 5 do
    for f in List.range 3 do
      count := count+1
      if !cleanupCheck m f then failures := failures+1
  for m in [8,16,32] do
    count := count+1
    if !cleanupCheck m 2 then failures := failures+1
  return (count,failures)
#eval checks
reason: Nested host-function interpretation was replaced by finite-bank materialization. A separate kernel check proves run equivalence for the list-based snapshot;the explicit finite-port variant has its own equality proof in its still-running check. Original runs were not counted as successful.
